description: You are a Clinical Systems Integration Engineer at a multi-site health system. The Practice Management System (PMS) sends SIU^S12 (Schedule Information Unsolicited - New Appointment Booking) messages when patients book appointments. The downstream EHR must pre-register patients as ADT^A04 (Pre-Admit/Register) encounters before their appointment. You must build a two-channel HL7 bridge in NextGen Connect: CHANNEL 1 - 'SIU Intake Channel': (a) Listens on TCP port 6666 for SIU^S12 messages using MLLP. (b) Contains a JavaScript transformer that maps SIU fields to ADT fields: constructs a new MSH segment with message type ADT^A04, copies patient demographics from PID segment (PID-3 MRN, PID-5 name, PID-7 DOB, PID-8 gender), extracts appointment datetime from SCH-11 (appointment start datetime), and stores the transformed ADT message as a string in the channel map variable 'transformedADT'. (c) Uses a Channel Writer destination (NOT a TCP sender) to forward the transformed message to CHANNEL 2 by channel name reference. CHANNEL 2 - 'ADT Pre-Registration Processor': (a) Receives messages from Channel 1 via Channel Writer. (b) Uses a Database Writer destination that INSERTs into a PostgreSQL table 'scheduling_preregistrations' with columns: appt_id VARCHAR, patient_mrn VARCHAR, patient_name VARCHAR, appt_datetime VARCHAR, registered_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(). (c) Must be deployed before Channel 1 can reference it. Both channels must be deployed. Sample SIU S12 message: /home/ga/sample_siu_s12.hl7. PostgreSQL inside container: jdbc:postgresql://nextgen-postgres:5432/mirthdb (user: postgres, password: postgres). Create table: docker exec nextgen-postgres psql -U postgres -d mirthdb -c 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scheduling_preregistrations (appt_id VARCHAR(50), patient_mrn VARCHAR(50), patient_name VARCHAR(200), appt_datetime VARCHAR(50), registered_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW());'. REST API: https://localhost:8443/api (credentials: admin/admin). All API calls require header: X-Requested-With: OpenAPI. The Channel Writer destination in Channel 1 must reference Channel 2's channel ID. Deploy Channel 2 first, then Channel 1.
